feed_title: Deep Memory Foam Dog Bed Mattress, 127 x 91cm, Raised Head Section, Waterproof Liner, Washable Microfibre Cover | PawLunova Wastwater
descriptionHtml:
127 × 91cm. A headrest in the foam. A waterproof liner underneath.

Wastwater is a deep memory foam dog mattress in one size, 127 × 91cm, with a raised head section built into the foam and a waterproof liner around the core.

A dog settling for the night puts the chin down last, and it goes down searching. A rolled edge, a cushion seam, the arm of the sofa. The body then arranges itself around wherever the head landed.

Here that rise is part of the mattress. One end of the foam is raised into a head section, with no wall to climb over.

What they get

  • Memory foam right through: A core that contours to them instead of filling that packs down.
  • A built-in headrest: A raised head section at one end, with no wall to climb.
  • 127 × 91cm of usable space: Every centimetre is sleeping area, with no bolsters.
  • A waterproof liner around the foam: Under the microfibre cover, it stops a wet night reaching the core.

Best for: Big dogs who sleep long, head-resters, and homes where wet nights happen.

Why it is worth the money

£165 buys floor space your dog can actually lie on. At this size most beds are bolstered, so you pay for a footprint they cannot use. Here the whole thing is bed, and the head rise is foam rather than a separate cushion. The core carries a 5-year no-flatten guarantee, and over the 1825 nights it covers that is about 9p a night. And you are not gambling the money. If they have not claimed it within 100 nights, we collect it free from the UK mainland and refund you in full.

One size, and it is a big one. It does not tuck in beside a chair and there is nothing smaller to fall back on.

Size and fit

SizeDimensions (cm)
One size127 × 91

Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly whether it fits.

Everyday care

Remove the cover and wash it following the sewn-in care label. Air-dry fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide. 5 years on the foam.

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. The foam core also has a 5-year no-flatten guarantee under normal domestic use, subject to the guarantee terms; cover wear and pet damage are not included. Read the full returns and guarantee terms. This guarantee is in addition to your statutory rights and does not affect them.

The questions we get asked most.

How do I know which size to get?

One size. Check their length against 127cm and width against 91cm.

Where exactly does the waterproof liner sit?

Around the foam core, underneath the microfibre cover you take off and wash.

Will it suit an older dog who finds it hard to get up?

Deep memory foam, a raised head end, no sides to climb. That question belongs with your vet.

Can I actually wash it?

Yes. The microfibre cover comes off and washes to the sewn-in label.

What if my dog just won't use it?

Then send it back. That is what the 100 nights are for. We collect it free from the UK mainland and refund you in full.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

Give the big dog all 127 × 91cm of it.
